product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides an AI-powered eDiscovery and investigations platform for law firms, corporate legal departments and legal service providers.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the homepage navigation/footer, and /pricing presents a demo-request form rather than named plans or prices.

named_customers.notes: Featured in Reveal AI and Logikcull customer success stories, respectively.

employee_band.notes: Headcount sources conflict, and LinkedIn's stated company-size range of 501–1,000 falls outside the permitted bands; no permitted band can be assigned confidently.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies Chicago as its North American headquarters and also lists regional headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is positioned as eDiscovery/legal-AI commentary and product guidance; no qualifying two-post engineering blog was identified.

public_docs.notes: Public product documentation includes getting-started, administration, AI-model and aji articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board listed seven openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: aji documentation references processing in a US-based AWS Bedrock region; it does not identify the underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center specifies SOC 2 Type 2. GDPR is a compliance framework, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists acquisition debt as the latest deal type but withholds its date and amount. CB Insights instead identifies the latest dated equity round as $200 million of growth equity in January 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: Funding history was found, but the latest acquisition-debt financing is publicly undated, preventing a reliable determination for the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Account Executive, II and Accounts Executive I postings both have application links.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, Reveal announced an Onna Claude connector for collecting and searching employees' AI conversations.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, dated executive roster was available. Eric Harmon's CEO appointment was announced October 14, 2025, outside the requested window; no qualifying later change could be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is explicitly used for the prospecting database; the other systems appear among preferred sales-tool experience in the AE posting.
